purpose: Fannie Mae DU and Freddie Mac LPA agency eligibility matrix. Checks DTI caps (DU/LPA: 50%; manual UW: 36% housing / 45% total), LTV/CLTV/HCLTV maximums by occupancy type (primary/second home/investment) and loan purpose (purchase/rate-term/cash-out), and multi-unit property constraints. Returns eligible_flag (ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE) and detailed per-check results. Table version: FNM-LPA-ELIGIBILITY-2026-01-01. Not compute_llpa_stack (LLPA pricing surcharges) or check_conforming_loan_limit (FHFA loan size limits).
